context: Tests whether the agent configures ShazamKit using SHManagedSession, handles matches and misses cleanly, demonstrates custom catalog usage, and respects microphone privacy.

checklist.name: SHManagedSession Implementation
checklist.description: Utilizes SHManagedSession and iterates over session.results using async/await sequence for iOS 17+ ambient audio recognition.

checklist.name: Match Result & Metadata Extraction
checklist.description: Extracts SHMatchedMediaItem metadata such as title and artist on match, and safely handles noMatch without treating it as an error.

checklist.name: Custom Catalog Workflow
checklist.description: Demonstrates creating, loading, or matching against an SHCustomCatalog with custom reference signatures.

checklist.name: On-Device Signature Generation
checklist.description: Explains or implements SHSignatureGenerator showing that compact acoustic signatures are produced locally rather than sending raw audio.

checklist.name: Privacy & Microphone Entitlement
checklist.description: Specifies NSMicrophoneUsageDescription in Info.plist and requests recording permission where applicable.
